declarations.type:
∀ {Candidate : Type} (rank : Candidate → Nat) (left right : Candidate),
  ∃ winner,
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinDeterministicRecoveryContention.DeterministicWinner
      (fun candidate => candidate = left ∨ candidate = right) rank winner

declarations.type:
∀ {Candidate : Type} (eligible : Candidate → Prop) (rank : Candidate → Nat),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinDeterministicRecoveryContention.InjectiveRank rank →
    ∀ (leftWinner rightWinner : Candidate),
      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinDeterministicRecoveryContention.DeterministicWinner eligible rank
          leftWinner →
        ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinDeterministicRecoveryContention.DeterministicWinner eligible rank
            rightWinner →
          leftWinner = rightWinner
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinDeterministicRecoveryContention.injective_rank_makes_winner_unique

declarations.type:
∃ eligible rank,
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinDeterministicRecoveryContention.DeterministicWinner eligible rank false ∧
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinDeterministicRecoveryContention.DeterministicWinner eligible rank
        true ∧
      false ≠ true
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinDeterministicRecoveryContention.noninjective_rank_can_admit_two_distinct_winners

declarations.type:

  (commit : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinDeterministicRecoveryContention.WinnerCommit Candidate),
  commit.committedLeaseEpoch = commit.previousLeaseEpoch + 1 ∧
    commit.committedPublicationRevision = commit.previousPublicationRevision + 1

  (left right :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinDeterministicRecoveryContention.ContentionRoundKey TransitionId
      CandidateSetDigest PolicyId SnapshotId),
  left.candidateSetDigest ≠ right.candidateSetDigest →

declarations.type:
∀ {TransitionId CandidateSetDigest PolicyId SnapshotId Candidate : Type}
  (left right :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinDeterministicRecoveryContention.ContentionRoundKey TransitionId
      CandidateSetDigest PolicyId SnapshotId)
  (winner : Candidate),
  left.candidateSetDigest ≠ right.candidateSetDigest →
    winner = winner ∧
      ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinDeterministicRecoveryContention.ContentionRoundCompatible left right
